scope: Development feasibility of a concrete credit estimator; previous allocator gates unchanged
allocation: uniform 4 reward samples per thought, all samples used; no pilot allocation
target: sample-std normalized conditional Bernoulli values with floor tau=1e-4; h_tau(p)
runtime_information: count vector, fixed count per group, frozen prior lookup only; no true p, score-Gram or unavailable outcomes

prior_fit.exchangeability: augment each support point with all24 coordinate permutations; equal weights

scale_control: single clipped scalar minimizing frozen finite-prior predictive update risk averaged over the same four primary fixed Grams; fit before reading development outcomes
grams: all seven frozen matrices from experiments.gradient_gate.core.grams; no new geometry
primary_estimand: mean fixed-Gram update MSE over four primary geometries and96 consumed vectors; equal mixture components; ratio of means
development_rule: Candidate requires >5% reduction vs both plug-in and frozen scale control, no >10% weighted exact-risk regression vs plug-in in any six stress regimes and four primary Grams, and half-support maximum credit-table difference <=0.02; otherwise stop this prototype
uncertainty: No fresh intervals. Outcome risks exact; continuous prior integration approximate. Bayes optimality holds only for the frozen finite support and fixed score geometry independent of unknown p
no_rescue: one prior, one estimator, one budget; no hyperparameter tuning, winner-selected geometry, distribution change or new confirmation
